Apple has been extending the testing period for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, and the company is now rolling out the seventh Release Candidate (RC) for both systems. Here are the details.

New Release Candidates Released

Four days ago, Apple released the sixth RC for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, along with the first RC for macOS 26.6 and its counterpart.

Looking at the timeline and the number of RCs, one would naturally assume these are the final testing builds before the official rollout. However, that is not the case.

Apple today released the seventh Release Candidate for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, with the following build numbers:

  • macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 (23J620)
  • macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 (24G824)

Both versions are now available for download by developers and public beta testers.

Apple has yet to announce the update details for these two systems, only repeating its standard official statement: "This update provides important security fixes and is recommended for all users." The company will most likely publish more details on the Apple security updates page after the two systems are officially released.

Apple has consistently been releasing updates for older versions of its systems, providing important bug fixes for users unable to upgrade to the latest software. This occasion should be no exception, so any users still on macOS Sonoma or Sequoia should install the update as soon as it is publicly released, which could come as early as the beginning of next week.
